CA.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation condition linked to identified content.

COD.rationale: Content (p0/current/n0/red), its organization (grid occupancy), and an explicit origin/status entry are present for the same referent/time.

A.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation or processing condition is linked to a content's presentation/access in the text.

C.rationale: Multiple explicit content identifiers with color attributes are listed (red/blue) for named referents and times.

D.rationale: The report separates identified content entries from explicit origin/status metadata (e.g. copied_prior_record, command_estimate), distinguishing content identity from status.

O.rationale: Candidate entries explicitly specify spatial/constituent patterns (groupings of coordinates) describing how content would be organized/presented.
